mods.name: CushionScreens
mods.description: Show images, GIFs, and videos (with optional audio) on a screen made of cushions.

releases.notes:
# Changelog

## 0.8.1

**New**
- `{safemode:true}` attribute for `/cushionscreens video` - loads and plays very long videos in 5-minute chunks instead of decoding the whole file upfront, so they start quickly and don't use huge amounts of memory. Works together with `loop`, `audio`, and `seek` (as the starting point). There's a short pause between chunks while the next one loads, since chunks aren't pre-fetched ahead of time yet.

## 0.8.0

First public release under the CushionScreens name. This version brought a large number of changes on top of the original private fork - grouped by topic rather than by internal build number, since 0.1.0–0.7.0 were never distributed anywhere.

**New commands**
- `/cushionscreens url <link> [{attrs}]` - download and show an image or GIF directly from an http(s) link (detected by file signature, not URL extension).
- `/cushionscreens pause` / `/cushionscreens resume` - freeze and continue the current frame/pattern (and audio) without reloading anything.
- `/cushionscreens maxframes <number>` - configurable cap on how many video frames get decoded (global setting, default 2000).

**New `{attributes}` syntax**
- Options that used to be separate literal flags (`colors=64`, `bake`) are now a single trailing NBT compound, e.g. `{colors:176,loop:true,volume:75,seek:30,scaling:fit}` - same style Minecraft uses for item components.
- `colors`: `16` (default), `17` (16 + one true black), `64` (copper bulb oxidation stages), `80` (64 + a non-glowing variant), `176` (all supported light levels).
- `loop`: video/GIF repeats forever (audio included) instead of stopping on a blank screen after playing once (new default: stop after one play-through).
- `volume`: 0-100, applied via the client's own audio gain control, independent of Minecraft's sound sliders.
- `seek`: start video (and its audio) partway in, using FFmpeg's fast input-side seeking.
- `scaling`: `stretch` (default, unchanged), `crop` (fill without distortion), `fit` (letterbox/pillarbox with black bars).

**Extended color system**
- Every screen now sits on a lit waxed copper bulb by default, so it glows at night even without using an extended color count.
- Colors 64/80/176 place a different light-emitting block under each cushion to unlock extra brightness levels per color; values are based on real in-game color measurements rather than a theoretical brightness curve.

**Persistence & lifecycle**
- A built screen is now remembered across server restarts and rejoining (previously had to be rebuilt every time).
- `bake` (image only): shows the image, then stops tracking those cushions as "the screen" - they become a permanent fixture, untouched by future commands.

**Audio**
- Video can now stream synced audio to players over the network (optionally to specific players/selectors only).
- Audio now stops automatically on disconnect/return to the title screen, and pauses/resumes together with the game's own pause menu (singleplayer only, as expected).

**Fixes**
- Fixed videos silently restarting/looping after roughly 2 minutes regardless of actual length (old hardcoded frame cap).
- Fixed a crash ("Invalid player data") that occurred specifically in creative mode / with cheats enabled, caused by an unregistered custom command argument type.
- Fixed a command parser error when combining `audio` with a target selector and trailing attributes.

**Renaming**
- Project, package, command name, author, and all identifiers changed from the original private fork to CushionScreens / atrixx.
